entities.name: Founding of the Republic (1944)
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The referendum dissolving the union with Denmark (97% in favour) and the proclamation of the Republic of Iceland at Þingvellir on 17 June 1944, followed by NATO membership (1949) despite no military forces.
